summary: Adds planned dashboard capabilities services.message.share (action service_message_share) and services.messages.read (readServiceMessages). A staff member records a message they ALREADY shared themselves with a saved Service Job's Order customer; ewatrade sends nothing. The canonical command creates one MANUAL/COMPLETED ServiceNotificationIntent plus one ServiceManualShare atomically in the caller's transaction, after locking Order then Job and re-reviewing. The recipient is always the Order snapshot. The provider dispatcher never selects it; customer tracking shows it. New native serviceCommunications.recordManualMessage and serviceCommunications.listMessages call the same canonical functions. No schema, provider, worker or mobile change.

capabilities.note: Owner/Admin/legacy Manager. Scoped Managers refused in the canonical command and centrally (no procedure grant). Exact active Store = Job Store, tenant and non-clinical guards. Dashboard only. Receipt uses the existing order kind (record = intent id, opens the Order).

Bounded newest-first history (20 intents, 3 shares and 3 attempts each), safe fields only, classified staff_reported_share/provider_* without inferring delivery or consent. Same authority as the write. Dashboard only.

procedures.reason: New thin native mutation calling recordServiceManualMessageInTransaction, the same canonical command used by services.message.share.
New thin native query calling listServiceJobMessagesInTransaction, the same bounded projection used by services.messages.read.

docs.note: New G05 manual-share feature, API and permission notes.

evidence.result: 8 pass offline with an in-memory transaction: review binding and revision drift; refusals (no phone for SMS/WhatsApp, not shared, bad text, scoped Manager, cashier, clinical, other Store, other tenant); Order-then-Job lock order and MANUAL/COMPLETED fact with share; replay and changed-payload/actor/recipient-drift refusal leaving facts unchanged; stale revision refused before write; dispatcher predicate excludes MANUAL and COMPLETED; bounded safe classified history; revoked/scoped completed replay refused unchanged. Concurrency is not exercised (unique index plus Job FOR UPDATE by source review only).

5 pass offline: review disclosure lines; server-owned recipient/Store/tenant (smuggled fields refused before any command); lock then review then record with the reviewed revision and proposal key; exact order receipt; canonical FORBIDDEN/CONFLICT mapping; central authority matrix for write and read (scoped Managers, cashier, operator, suspended and mobile refused; planned rollout refused). Canonical commands stood in.
Strict contract; within packages/assistant/src 238 pass, 22 skip.
